_doc: Every dynamic site of the money import closure, pinned for scripts/check_research_data_fence.py (Governance, route A, 2026-11-18). A site the fence finds that is not pinned here by file, line and the sha256 of its stripped line -- a new site, or a pinned one whose line changed or moved -- FAILS the fence closed. A pin is not a proof the site cannot reach the research-data home; it records that the site was read as it stands, so any change to it is read again before the fence goes green. Re-pin only after reading the new line.
